name: ask-gina-plugins
description: Research assistant for crypto, prediction, and perpetual markets.

plugins.name: ask-gina
plugins.description: Ask Gina is a research assistant for crypto, prediction markets, perpetuals, and equities. Use it to fetch real-time prices and historical data for tokens, Hyperliquid markets, and Polymarket prediction markets, and to analyze your Gina wallet, positions, and accounts. Gina cannot place trades or transfer assets inside Claude.

plugins.name: ask-gina-perps
plugins.description: Ask Gina Perps lets an agent read Hyperliquid account and market data and, with your approval, place, change and cancel perpetual-futures orders, adjust leverage, and deposit or withdraw funds from your Gina wallet. It also renders charts, positions and account overviews. Orders and funding move real money, so review every action before you approve it.

plugins.name: ask-gina-predictions
plugins.description: Ask Gina Predictions lets an agent search Polymarket markets, read your positions and order history, and, with your approval, place trades, manage orders, redeem winning positions, and top up or withdraw your prediction balance from your Gina wallet. It also manages scheduled prompts. Trades and balance changes move real funds, so review every action before you approve it.

plugins.name: ask-gina-spot
plugins.description: Ask Gina Spot lets an agent quote and, with your approval, execute spot token swaps, transfers, and liquidity-pool operations from your Gina wallet. It also reads swap history, wallet addresses, LP positions, and operation status, and it includes skills for scanning liquidity pools and rebalancing LP positions. Transactions move real funds, so review every quote before you approve it.
